Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm, which grows more than 30,000 pounds of free produce a year, was at risk of shutting down. It had paused paid apprenticeships, cut staff hours and launched a $200,000 fundraising campaign. Farm organizers said it faced a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ended.
